Key visual features: White, powdery circular patches on the upper leaf surface of tomato leaves. The spots are discrete, round, and have a chalky/powdery texture. No water-soaked lesions, no concentric rings, no yellowing halos.

This strongly matches **Powdery_Mildew** — "White, powdery sporulation on both the tops and undersides of leaves, in round spots that begin small but expand and converge."

The reference images confirm the match — white powdery patches on leaf surfaces, identical to the discrete chalky-white circular spots visible in the test image. The test image shows early-stage powdery mildew with discrete round white sporulation patches on the upper leaf surface.
